title: Metropolitan Tabernacle Pulpit
author: C. H. Spurgeon
tradition_notes: Spurgeon was the Pastor of the Metropolitan Tabernacle, London (1854-1892). His theology was strongly Calvinist and shaped by the Puritan tradition. The MTP sermons span his entire ministry and are the largest single corpus of his preaching.
source_edition: Retained Kingdom Collective HTML sermon pages.
notes: Spurgeon died in 1892; the underlying sermons are public domain. Retained primary wording says the collection was "transcribed from manuscripts edited by Emmett O'Donnell" and states "Designed by Benry Yip." It does not identify the transcriber or digitizer; those responsibilities remain unresolved. Legacy canonical JSON is an aid outside this campaign, not candidate authority, and remains untouched under the protected-path rule. Output is split into per-chunk files (sermons-<start>-<end>.json, 100 sermons per file) to stay under GitHub's 100 MB file-size limit.
